explanation: It fires only at the GO step, only very late in the episode (about trial 90 onward), when the agent chooses a2 right after a trial where a2 led to S1 by a rare transition and got no reward: about 6-8 the first time, rising to 9-10 if the trial before that was also an unrewarded rare trial (about 3 if it is before trial 93). Every other case is 0: all D1 and D2 steps, any a1 choice, any trial before about 90, and a GO that follows a rewarded trial or an unrewarded common trial (at most 1).
